use_case_summary: Customer runs a mid-market B2B SaaS product search and recommendations feature. They need embed generation at scale (daily batch of ~100M records over longer rollout) and sub-50ms 95th percentile vector search for interactive product-search UX. Also want reranking pipeline where embeddings + LLM reranker run in chain for top-K results. High throughput during nightly batch windows; cost sensitivity for embeddings generation and for per-query unit cost.
technical_requirements: 95th percentile query latency < 50ms for top-k vector retrieval (regionally routed)
Support for bulk embedding jobs (100M rows) with retryable batching and resumable checkpoints
Vector DB connector (prefer Postgres + vector extension, and option for Pinecone/Milvus integration)
KV cache support for recent queries, to lower token counts on reranker calls
Audit logging for inference requests and retention controls for vectors and prompts
poc_plan: Week 0: Data share / security kick — SFQ responses + simple NDA amendments
Week 1: Hosted POC — ingest 1M vectors, run latency benchmarks for embeddings + searches
Week 2: Scale to 10M vectors; run nightly batch job simulation (throughput and cost report)
Week 3: Integrate reranker chain and measure end-to-end UX latency and token costs
Optional Week 4: Short Dedicated pilot (reserved nodes) to validate tail latency and cost per-query at scale
pricing_concerns: Wants clearer mapping between nightly batch embed costs vs interactive query costs. Asks for a committed Dedicated price sheet for peak windows plus overflow hosted rates. Concerned about egress/storage costs when vector snapshots are stored in their cloud.
decision_criteria: Total cost of ownership vs current Faiss+OpenAI pipeline
Security posture (SOC2 + KMS + SSO) and audit capabilities
Operational simplicity: ability to pin model versions and run canary rollouts
Clear fallbacks / routing when Dedicated capacity saturated
